recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-15627 unless PA later chooses to revisit eligibility criteria modeling beyond the already-applied FHIR-41782 structure.
issue_request: The Applied/Persuasive with Modification PA tracker asked to change HealthcareService.eligibility so social and health service eligibility requirements could be represented programmatically across multiple data types and resources, using a BackboneElement to store screening criteria.
initial_application: The application was not a standalone FHIR-15627-only edit. Commit a2b02dee29 explicitly named FHIR-15627 with FHIR-41782 and FHIR-39306 and expanded HealthcareService.eligibility from code/comment into a BackboneElement with code, value[x], comment, period, and an invariant requiring code when value is present. Follow-up HealthcareService commits added the missed ValueSet binding, attached invariant conditions, corrected eligibility.period to Period, and corrected the specialist-referral-required sample-code spelling.
additional_context: FHIR-41782 is Applied/Persuasive and records the detailed approved shape for HealthcareService.eligibility, including the value[x] data types and alignment with Group characteristics. PA September 2023 WGM minutes state that FHIR-15627 was already met by FHIR-41782 changes and passed the seed resolution 4-0-0. HealthcareService is active and approved in source/fhir.ini, and Zulip searches found no directly relevant conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current build-scope HealthcareService source already has eligibility as a structured BackboneElement with code, value[x], comment, period, the hcs-1 invariant, an eligibility example CodeSystem/ValueSet, and referralRequired guidance that references the eligibility structure.

related_jiras.note: Applied/Persuasive HealthcareService tracker whose eligibility resolution and source application are the mechanism PA cited as satisfying FHIR-15627; it was already represented on the combined branch.
Earlier HealthcareService eligibility example code-set work refined by FHIR-41782; it helped shape the example binding but was not independently decided here.
